Amumu.build: Amumu E Tantrum reduces physical damage taken, so prioritize armor penetration or attack alongside allied magic damage. Build magic resistance against the magic damage from Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu W Despair, and avoid relying on a large health pool because of W. Amumu P Cursed Touch's true damage cannot be mitigated with resistances.
Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stuns and catches you on hit, so dodge it with a minion or jungle monster between you. When Amumu has Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy available, don't group with allies, and keep your distance before fighting in a narrow passage. Amumu W Despair deals continuous damage based on your maximum health at close range, so don't stay near him for long.
Amumu.combo: When you have an angle to get onto Amumu, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and lock him down with Vi R Cease and Desist. If you're in range to start with Vi R Cease and Desist, follow the knock-up with basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Attack the same target so Vi W Denting Blows stacks don't get split.
Amumu.escape: Amumu has no skill that creates distance, so engage when Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. Follow with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist.
Amumu.fight: Once Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker. Once you're on him, keep attacking the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, but don't prolong trades inside Amumu W Despair.
Amumu.laning: When ganking, hit the target from behind with Vi Q Vault Breaker to knock them toward your allied laner. Keep a minion between you and Amumu when watching for Amumu Q Bandage Toss.
Amumu.phase: In the late game, Vi should focus on engaging and isolating a target over dealing damage.
Amumu.teamfight: When Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from your allies and fight in open terrain; if possible, commit to the engage after the ability is down. Move within range for your allies to follow, then isolate one key enemy damage dealer with Vi R Cease and Desist. Attack only that target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape or knock them toward your allies.

Belveth.teamfight: Move within range for your allies to follow, then use Vi R Cease and Desist to catch one key damage dealer. Keep attacking that target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape or knock them toward your allies. If an ally dies and drops Void Coral, retreat before Bel'Veth can pick it up, and don't fight again while she is transformed.
Belveth.build: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal primarily physical damage, so build armor first. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet's true damage cannot be mitigated with resistances, so rely on your total health. If Bel'Veth's sustain makes her too hard to kill even when you catch her, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Belveth.combo: For a gank, charge Vi Q Vault Breaker and knock the target back on impact, then follow with empowered basic attack from Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack. If you start by catching them with Vi R Cease and Desist, follow the moment the knock-up ends with basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first to knock the target away can interrupt the follow-up.
Belveth.escape: Dodging Bel'Veth W Above and Below prevents the reset on Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, slowing her pursuit. Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, so engage during the opening when she can't immediately dash again in the direction she just dashed in. At that point, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and block her escape with Vi R Cease and Desist.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below sideways, then engage with crowd control before Bel'Veth Q Void Surge comes back. Close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker, then lock her down with Vi R Cease and Desist. Once you're on her, keep attacking one target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows.
Belveth.laning: When ganking, position behind the target so Vi Q Vault Breaker knocks them toward your allied laner.
Belveth.phase: Bel'Veth's stacks are permanent, putting you at a greater disadvantage as time goes on, so focus on engaging and isolating targets as Vi in the late game.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, so when Bel'Veth closes in, dodge by cutting sideways instead of running straight back. Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces damage taken while it spins, so wait for it to end instead of unloading Vi's attacks. Delay the fight while Bel'Veth is transformed by Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.

Elise.laning: Secure plenty of vision early and don't push the lane recklessly while Elise is out of sight. When ganking, approach from behind so Vi Q Vault Breaker knocks Elise toward your allies.
Elise.phase: Early on, watch for Elise trying to build an advantage through ganks, avoid giving up kills, and stall for time. In the late game, focus on engaging and isolating a key target over dealing damage.
Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise's main ability damage. Also get armor against her basic attack damage, and if Elise P Spider Queen's healing makes her too hard to kill even when caught, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Elise.combo: Don't use Vi R Cease and Desist while Elise can't be targeted during Elise E Rappel; wait for her to land. After knocking her up with Vi R Cease and Desist, prepare Vi E Relentless Force during her descent, then follow as the knock-up ends with basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first can knock Elise away and interrupt the follow-up.
Elise.escape: The moment after both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down is a window to counter-engage. You can also close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker right after Elise uses Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, and catch her with Vi R Cease and Desist when Elise E Rappel can't make her untargetable.
Elise.fight: After dodging Elise E Cocoon, make her use Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, then close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker. Once you're on her, keep attacking without switching targets to trigger Vi W Denting Blows. After Elise E Rappel is down, you can catch her with Vi R Cease and Desist.
Elise.teamfight: Move within range for your allies to follow, then use Vi R Cease and Desist to target one key enemy damage dealer. After engaging, keep attacking the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape or knock them toward your allies. If you target Elise, don't use Vi R Cease and Desist while she can't be targeted during Elise E Rappel.
Elise.watch: If Elise E Cocoon hits you, you can be stunned and take attacks from Elise R Spider Form, so dodge with a minion or jungle monster between you. When Elise switches to Elise R Spider Form, she is looking to finish you, so manage distance with Vi Q Vault Breaker and use Vi P Blast Shield. Elise cannot be targeted during Elise E Rappel, so use Vi R Cease and Desist after she lands.

Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channels before entering, so interrupt it with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist when you see it being cast. If you can’t interrupt it, move outside its range and wait out its duration. Skills that hit from outside your vision can apply Terrify, so watch bushes and narrow entrances.
Fiddlesticks.build: If Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest's healing makes him too hard to kill even when you catch him, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Build magic resistance, not armor, against Fiddlesticks' damage. Movement speed is also important in case you can't escape with Vi Q Vault Breaker, so you can get out of Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm's area.
Fiddlesticks.combo: If you start with Vi R Cease and Desist, prepare Vi E Relentless Force during the knock-up, then follow as the target lands with basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first to knock the target away can interrupt the follow-up. If you need to interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest or Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, use Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist at that moment.
Fiddlesticks.escape: When Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap's silence are down, that's also a good time to engage with Vi Q Vault Breaker. If you can't interrupt Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, don't continue the fight; leave its area.
Fiddlesticks.fight: Don't switch targets so the stacks from Vi W Denting Blows trigger.
Fiddlesticks.laning: When ganking, hit the target from behind with Vi Q Vault Breaker to knock them toward your allied laner. While Fiddlesticks is out of sight, maintain vision in the bushes behind the lane, and don't walk past an unconfirmed Scarecrow Effigy.
Fiddlesticks.phase: In the late game, Vi should focus on engaging and isolating targets over dealing damage.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm all hit an area, so spread out from your allies and don't group in narrow passages without vision. Secure vision in the bushes and entry paths near objectives, and interrupt Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist when you see the cast. To engage, use Vi R Cease and Desist from within range for your allies to follow, then focus on the one target you catch.

Hecarim.build: Build armor first to prepare for Hecarim’s main damage sources, Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, use Vi Q Vault Breaker to disrupt Hecarim’s movement and reduce his ability to approach and deal damage. Once you’re on him, keep attacking Hecarim without switching targets to trigger Vi W Denting Blows stacks.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks you back farther the farther he has run, so be wary if he runs around the opposite side, as he may be building distance. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear grouped allies all at once, so spread out before he engages.
Hecarim.combo: If Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is down, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and lock him down with Vi R Cease and Desist. Prepare Vi E Relentless Force while he is knocked up, then chain basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker when the knock-up ends. If you use Vi Q Vault Breaker first and push Hecarim away, you may interrupt the follow-up combo.
Hecarim.escape: Keep in mind that Hecarim can escape with his remaining ability if only one of Hecarim E Devastating Charge and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is down. In particular, look for a chance to close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and lock him down with Vi R Cease and Desist before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back.
Hecarim.laning: When ganking, position behind Hecarim so Vi Q Vault Breaker pushes him toward your allied laner.
Hecarim.phase: In the mid game, start fights with Vi Q Vault Breaker and Vi R Cease and Desist while Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is down. Later on, Vi’s role shifts toward engaging and isolating one target rather than dealing damage.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t fear several of you at once. Before using Vi R Cease and Desist, walk in until your allies can follow. Lock down one of the enemy’s key damage dealers and focus them until the stacks of Vi W Denting Blows trigger, then use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape route or push them toward your allies.

Brand.build: Build magic resistance first against Brand's main damage. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your maximum health, so consider movement speed to get out of telegraphed areas instead of only stacking health.
Brand.combo: For a gank, charge Vi Q Vault Breaker to knock Brand toward your allies, then follow with empowered basic attack from Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack. If you start with Vi R Cease and Desist, prepare Vi E Relentless Force during the knock-up, then follow as it ends with basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker.
Brand.escape: Engage with Vi Q Vault Breaker the moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. Brand Q Sear cannot stun you if you aren't ablaze, so use that opening. If you're already ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear before engaging.
Brand.fight: Use the moment after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down to engage with Vi Q Vault Breaker. Once you're on him, keep attacking one target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, then get out of the damage area before Brand can follow up with his next ability.
Brand.laning: Brand E Conflagration can spread from a burning minion, so don't go for last hits next to one. Vi E Relentless Force can hit the minion in front to pressure Brand behind it.
Brand.phase: In the late game, Vi should focus on engaging and isolating targets over dealing damage.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing. Move within range for your allies to follow, then target Brand with Vi R Cease and Desist and focus on him until Vi W Denting Blows triggers. Use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block Brand's escape or knock him toward your allies.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks and explodes when you get hit by consecutive abilities, so dodge his first ability, especially Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand Q Sear. While you're ablaze, Brand Q Sear can stun you, so move out of its projectile's path or hide behind a minion. When Brand R Pyroclasm appears, spread out from allies to avoid its bounces.

Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar's main damage. Briar E Chilling Scream and Briar R Certain Death deal magic damage, so armor alone won't stop them, and Briar Q Head Rush reduces resistances. If Briar's healing makes her too hard to kill in a prolonged fight, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Briar.combo: When ganking, charge Vi Q Vault Breaker, collide with the target, and knock them toward your allies, then follow with empowered basic attack from Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack. If you start with Vi R Cease and Desist, follow as the knock-up ends with basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. If Briar is charging Briar E Chilling Scream, interrupt her first with the crowd control from Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist.
Briar.escape: Don't engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down. Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and Briar R Certain Death can also be used to engage and move, so look especially for an opening before Briar R Certain Death comes back. Close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch her with Vi R Cease and Desist.
Briar.fight: If you lower Briar's health in the jungle, she has to find another fight to heal, which can delay her next path. Before a fight, activate Vi P Blast Shield and keep attacking one target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows. When Briar charges at you with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, take it in front, and interrupt Briar E Chilling Scream with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist.
Briar.laning: Push the lane and establish vision to create a chance to counter Briar's reckless ganks. Don't linger in the middle of a lane where you have no vision.
Briar.phase: In the late game, Vi's role grows more around engaging and isolating one target than dealing more damage.
Briar.teamfight: Stay on the frontline so Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack can't reach your backline, and take Briar R Certain Death's bloodstone hit in front so your backline damage dealers don't become prey. Before engaging with Vi R Cease and Desist, walk within range for your allies to follow. Once you've chosen a target, attack only that one to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape or knock them toward your allies.
Briar.watch: Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack chases and heals Briar against the nearest enemy, so take it in front of your allied damage dealers. When Briar starts charging Briar E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist, and don't fight with your back to a wall. If Briar R Certain Death hits you, move toward your allies to fight back together instead of fleeing alone.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance before armor against Ekko's damage. If Ekko R Chronobreak's healing makes him too hard to kill even when you catch him, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Ekko.combo: Start with Vi R Cease and Desist when Ekko E Phase Dive or Ekko R Chronobreak is down. As the knock-up ends, follow with basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first to knock Ekko away can interrupt the follow-up.
Ekko.escape: Don't go deep as soon as only Ekko E Phase Dive is down. Wait for both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak to be down, then close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, he has no mobility spell available, so catch him with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist. If Ekko R Chronobreak is also ready, don't overcommit to killing him in one go; make him use it, then engage again. Once you've caught him, keep attacking without switching targets to trigger Vi W Denting Blows.
Ekko.laning: When ganking, approach from behind so Ekko is knocked toward your allied laner when hit by Vi Q Vault Breaker. Approach while avoiding the area marked by the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence.
Ekko.phase: In the late game, Vi should focus on engaging and isolating targets over dealing damage, and look for opportunities when Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.teamfight: Walk within range for your allies to follow, then use Vi R Cease and Desist to isolate one key damage dealer. If the target is Ekko, look for an opening right after Ekko E Phase Dive or when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. Keep attacking the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape or knock them toward your allies.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid the marked area to prevent the stun and stop Ekko from gaining a shield. Also move out of the path where Ekko Q Timewinder returns. If you see Ekko's afterimage following him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don't overcommit to the chase even when health is low.

Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first to account for the magic damage from Evelynn Q Hate Spike, Evelynn W Allure, and Evelynn E Whiplash. Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, and Evelynn E Whiplash deals max-health-based damage, so prioritize retreating before the mark matures over stacking health alone. If Evelynn P Demon Shade’s healing means you can catch her but not finish her, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Evelynn.combo: After Evelynn R Last Caress is down, approach with Vi Q Vault Breaker and lock her down with Vi R Cease and Desist. After Vi R Cease and Desist knocks her up, chain basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker at the moment she finishes landing. If you hit her first with Vi Q Vault Breaker and knock her back, you may interrupt the follow-up attacks.
Evelynn.escape: Evelynn can escape with Evelynn E Whiplash and Evelynn R Last Caress, so don’t engage hastily when only one is down. In particular, look for an opening before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back and before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures. Evelynn can’t be targeted while casting Evelynn R Last Caress, so don’t use Vi R Cease and Desist at that moment.
Evelynn.fight: Before engaging, hit a nearby minion or monster with an ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield and help withstand the opening attack. Retreat while the mark from Evelynn W Allure is maturing, and close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker once Evelynn R Last Caress is down. After getting on her, keep hitting the same target to trigger the stacks of Vi W Denting Blows.
Evelynn.laning: Keep a Control Ward ready, and place a regular ward beside the jungle camp where Evelynn could start a fight. If you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, retreat immediately and alert your allies with a minimap ping and chat.
Evelynn.phase: Later on, Vi should focus on engaging and isolating targets rather than dealing damage, and watch for Evelynn looking for your backline.
Evelynn.teamfight: Keep your allied damage dealers inside an area where you have vision, and lock Evelynn down with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist when she engages. Before using Vi R Cease and Desist, walk in until your allies can follow. Once you choose a target, keep hitting that one champion until Vi W Denting Blows triggers, then use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape route or push them toward your allies.
Evelynn.watch: If you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, she is preparing a charm, so retreat into your allies’ vision before the mark matures. When health is low, Evelynn R Last Caress deals much more damage, and she can’t be targeted while casting it.

Gragas.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Gragas Q Barrel Roll, Gragas W Drunken Rage, and Gragas E Body Slam. Stacking health alone also increases the max-health-based damage from Gragas W Drunken Rage. If Gragas P Happy Hour’s healing makes him hard to finish even when you catch him, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Gragas.combo: If Gragas E Body Slam is down, get in first with Vi R Cease and Desist and knock him up. Prepare Vi E Relentless Force during the landing time, then chain basic attack → empowered Vi E Relentless Force basic attack → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. If you use Vi Q Vault Breaker first and push Gragas away, you may interrupt the follow-up combo.
Gragas.escape: The moment after Gragas E Body Slam is down is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker, then lock him down with Vi R Cease and Desist. After being hit by Gragas E Body Slam, don’t fight back where you are; first move outside the radius of Gragas Q Barrel Roll.
Gragas.fight: If Gragas starts drinking with Gragas W Drunken Rage, don’t commit your damage; wait for the effect to end. Close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker right after Gragas uses Gragas E Body Slam, then keep hitting one target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows’ armor reduction. Before the fight, hit a nearby minion or monster with an ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield and help withstand the opening combo.
Gragas.laning: When ganking, hit the enemy from behind with Vi Q Vault Breaker to push them toward your allied laner. If Gragas is behind minions, use Vi E Relentless Force to hit the minions in front and threaten him behind them.
Gragas.phase: Gragas has strong burst and teamfight disruption in the early and mid game, so hold your formation and endure fights around objectives. His sustained damage weakens later, improving the matchup; Vi should focus on engaging and isolating targets rather than dealing damage.
Gragas.teamfight: Avoid narrow passages and brush without vision, and don’t let your backline stand alone within Gragas E Body Slam range. Approach until your allies can follow, then use Vi R Cease and Desist to isolate one of the enemy’s key damage dealers. Keep hitting only that target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape route or push them toward your allies.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move outside its radius immediately. If you also get hit by Gragas E Body Slam near the barrel, you’ll take both abilities, so check where the barrel is even when using Vi Q Vault Breaker to engage. When Gragas has Gragas R Explosive Cask available, don’t stand with your back to the enemy team or a turret.

Graves.build: Buy Plated Steelcaps early and prioritize armor. Graves’s main damage from Graves P New Destiny, Graves Q End of the Line, and Graves R Collateral Damage is physical, while armor does not reduce the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen.
Graves.combo: When ganking, chain Vi Q Vault Breaker charge → impact → empowered basic attack from Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack. If you start with Vi R Cease and Desist, knock Graves up and prepare Vi E Relentless Force during his descent, then chain basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. If you use Vi Q Vault Breaker first and push Graves away, you may interrupt the follow-up combo.
Graves.escape: If only Graves E Quickdraw is down, check his remaining escape options, since he can still get away with Graves R Collateral Damage. In particular, before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and lock him down with Vi R Cease and Desist. If Graves W Smoke Screen is down, you can engage without its slow and vision denial.
Graves.fight: Trade back or close the gap while Graves reloads after firing two shots. Before engaging, hit a nearby minion or monster with an ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield; after getting on him, keep hitting the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows. Fight in open terrain where you have room to dodge the explosion from Graves Q End of the Line.
Graves.laning: When ganking, charge Vi Q Vault Breaker and approach from behind to push Graves toward your allied laner on impact. Early on, push or pressure the lane to limit Graves’s chances to build stacks of Graves E Quickdraw.
Graves.phase: Keep pressuring Graves’s space to build stacks in the mid game as well. Graves gets stronger over time and the matchup worsens, so focus on Vi’s engage and target isolation later on.
Graves.teamfight: Walk in until your allies can follow, then use Vi R Cease and Desist on one of the enemy’s key damage dealers. After getting on them, attack only that target until the stacks of Vi W Denting Blows trigger. Use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape route or push them toward your allies.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in narrow jungle passages. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, you’ll be slowed and lose vision, so leave its area by the shortest route, then use Vi Q Vault Breaker to re-engage. Graves P New Destiny’s basic attacks are blocked by the first unit hit, so fight with a minion or ally between you and him.

Ivern.build: If allies follow up on the root from Ivern Q Rootcaller and the knock-up from Ivern R Daisy!, consider tenacity first. If you build resistance against Ivern’s ability damage, choose magic resistance over armor. If the enemy composition can lock you down after you engage with Vi R Cease and Desist, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Ivern.combo: If Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, charge Vi Q Vault Breaker to close the gap and push the opponent toward your allies on impact, then chain an empowered basic attack from Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack. If you start with Vi R Cease and Desist, prepare Vi E Relentless Force during the landing phase, then attack in this order when the knock-up ends: basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. If you use Vi Q Vault Breaker first at this point, you may push the target away and interrupt the follow-up combo.
Ivern.escape: Ivern Q Rootcaller is Ivern’s only mobility tool, so the moment after you make him use it is your chance to close the gap. Approach with Vi Q Vault Breaker and use Vi R Cease and Desist. If Ivern E Triggerseed is already on a target, wait until the shield detonates before engaging so you don’t get slowed and left unable to retreat.
Ivern.fight: Engage after Ivern E Triggerseed detonates, and keep attacking the target you've engaged to trigger Vi W Denting Blows. Vi P Blast Shield activates when you hit an enemy or structure with an ability, so you can shield yourself before a fight by hitting a nearby minion or monster with an ability. Focus on one of Ivern's allies whom he shields rather than chasing Ivern deep into the fight.
Ivern.laning: Early on, warding Ivern’s jungle can reveal his route as he comes to harvest camps where he planted seeds. Don’t pass carelessly beside brush that suddenly appears from Ivern W Brushmaker.
Ivern.phase: Later on, Vi’s role is to engage and isolate targets rather than deal damage; focus on catching one of Ivern's allies who receives his shield instead of spending time chasing him.
Ivern.teamfight: Walk in until your allies can follow, then use Vi R Cease and Desist to isolate one of the enemy’s key damage dealers. Keep attacking only that target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape route or push them toward your allies. If Ivern E Triggerseed is already on the target, time your engage for after the shield detonates.
Ivern.watch: If you’re rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern’s allies can dash in, so position with a minion or terrain between you and him before he fires. Don’t engage a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed right away. If Ivern R Daisy! starts hitting you repeatedly, move away to avoid the knock-up from her third attack.

JarvanIV.build: Basic attacks and attack speed are also key sources of damage, so reducing the opponent’s attack speed can help.
JarvanIV.combo: Get in first with Vi R Cease and Desist and knock the target up, then prepare Vi E Relentless Force during the landing time. When the knock-up ends, chain basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker.
JarvanIV.fight: Before a fight, hit a minion or monster with an ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield and help absorb the opening attack.
JarvanIV.laning: When ganking, approach from behind so Vi Q Vault Breaker pushes the enemy toward your allied laner.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Approach until your allies can follow, then engage one of the enemy’s key damage dealers with Vi R Cease and Desist. Keep attacking that target to trigger the stacks of Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape route or push them toward your allies.

Jax.build: First consider an item that reduces attack speed to counter Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals max-health-based damage, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Jax.combo: If Jax E Counter Strike has ended and Jax Q Leap Strike is down, get in with Vi R Cease and Desist and knock him up. Prepare Vi E Relentless Force during the landing time, then chain basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker when the knock-up ends. If you use Vi Q Vault Breaker first, you may push Jax away and interrupt the follow-up combo.
Jax.escape: The moment after you make Jax use Jax Q Leap Strike is your window to close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker. Wait until the stun from Jax E Counter Strike also ends, then follow up with Vi R Cease and Desist to limit his chance to escape.
Jax.fight: Stop basic attacking while Jax E Counter Strike is active and move out of its stun range. Once Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is also down, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and keep hitting one target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in melee trades at level 1, so don’t force your way into close range when you only have one ability.
Jax.phase: Later on, Vi’s role shifts toward engaging and isolating targets rather than dealing damage.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, don’t group with your allies; wait for the area stun to end. Right after, chain crowd control with Vi Q Vault Breaker and Vi R Cease and Desist. When going for a key damage dealer, use Vi R Cease and Desist from within follow-up range of your allies, keep focusing only that target, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape route or push them toward your allies.
Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t use basic attacks or Vi E Relentless Force; retreat outside its stun range. Since Jax can close in with Jax Q Leap Strike and then reactivate Counter Strike to stun in an area, save Vi Q Vault Breaker so you can create distance at that moment.

Karthus.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can avoid Karthus W Wall of Pain and quickly leave the area of Karthus E Defile. Build magic resistance, not armor, against Karthus’s damage. Even with resistance, your first priority is choosing a route that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain.
Karthus.combo: Charge and hit with Vi Q Vault Breaker from behind to push Karthus toward your allies, then chain a basic attack empowered by Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack. If you start with Vi R Cease and Desist, use basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker as Karthus lands after the knock-up. If you kill Karthus, immediately move away from his body to avoid the abilities from Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.escape: After closing the gap, lock Karthus down with Vi R Cease and Desist. If the wall is laid across your engage route, don’t push through it.
Karthus.fight: Close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker along a route that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain. Once you’re on him, keep hitting the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and don’t stay in the area of Karthus E Defile for long. After the fight, check whether you have enough health left to withstand Karthus R Requiem.
Karthus.laning: When ganking, position behind Karthus so Vi Q Vault Breaker pushes him toward your allied laner. Pressure Karthus while he farms, dodging the warning area for Karthus Q Lay Waste.
Karthus.phase: In the mid game, after learning Vi R Cease and Desist, lock down Karthus from within follow-up range of your allies. Later on, focus on Vi’s engage and isolation role, and watch out for the damage Karthus P Death Defied can still deal even after you kill him.
Karthus.teamfight: Approach until your allies can follow, then target Karthus with Vi R Cease and Desist; while he’s locked down, hit only that target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows. Use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block Karthus’s escape route or push him toward your allies. After killing Karthus, move away from his body at once, and don’t stay within Karthus E Defile’s range for long.
Karthus.watch: Passing through Karthus W Wall of Pain slows you and lowers your magic resistance, making the following Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus R Requiem more dangerous. Go around the wall and walk out of the warning area for Karthus Q Lay Waste. Even immediately after you kill Karthus, he can cast abilities with Karthus P Death Defied, so move away from his body at once.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first to defend against Lee Sin's main damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple deals magic damage, so armor won't stop it. If the composition leaves you locked down and unable to escape after engaging with Vi R Cease and Desist, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
LeeSin.combo: Before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back up, approach with Vi Q Vault Breaker and use Vi R Cease and Desist. After knocking him up with Vi R Cease and Desist, chain basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack as he lands, and if Vi Q Vault Breaker is still available, use it last to knock him away. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first can knock him away and interrupt the follow-up.
LeeSin.escape: The moment Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike goes down is your chance to engage. If Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is still available, he can escape, so don't go in recklessly just because one mobility ability is down. Focus your damage and use Vi R Cease and Desist to block his escape as soon as he uses Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to engage.
LeeSin.fight: If you meet Lee Sin in the early-game jungle, don't take the duel. When fighting, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker while Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is down, then keep attacking the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows. Before engaging, hitting a nearby monster with an ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield can help you withstand the first attack.
LeeSin.laning: If you expect a Lee Sin gank, put a minion or jungle monster between you and him to block the straight path of Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave. Lee Sin can cross a wall you can't see beyond with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, so clear wards or stand away from the wall.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so back off if you meet him in the jungle. Lee Sin falls off in late game, so buy time with objectives and lane advantages, while Vi focuses on engaging and isolating a target.
LeeSin.teamfight: Before a teamfight, spread out so Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage doesn't knock up multiple allies, and don't stand stacked behind a high-health ally. Approach to a distance your allies can follow, then use Vi R Cease and Desist to target a key damage dealer. Keep attacking that target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape route or knock them toward your allies.
LeeSin.watch: Don't leave Lee Sin room to get behind you, or he can knock you away from your team with Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Stand with a wall or your frontline behind you.

MasterYi.build: Build health against the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, and consider ways to reduce attack speed to slow his basic attacks and Master Yi Q Alpha Strike cooldown. If Master Yi W Meditate's healing makes him hard to kill even when you catch him, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
MasterYi.combo: After Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands, knock him up with Vi R Cease and Desist. Prepare Vi E Relentless Force while he is airborne, then as the knock-up ends, chain basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first can knock Master Yi away and interrupt the follow-up.
MasterYi.escape: The moment after you make Master Yi use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, his mobility ability, is your chance to engage. When Master Yi lands, approach with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, don't rely on slows; use Vi's knockback or knock-up.
MasterYi.fight: Make Master Yi use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, then close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker when he lands and catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist. Keep attacking the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, reducing his armor and increasing Vi's attack speed. If Master Yi activates Master Yi W Meditate, interrupt it with the crowd control from Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist, if either is still available.
MasterYi.laning: When ganking, approach from behind and hit the enemy with Vi Q Vault Breaker to knock them toward your allied laner. Master Yi is weak at early jungling and ganking, so secure early objectives to disrupt his growth.
MasterYi.phase: In mid game, after learning Vi R Cease and Desist, look for the moment Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends to catch a target. Master Yi gets stronger as the game goes on, so in late game focus on Vi's role of engaging and isolating targets.
MasterYi.teamfight: Approach to a distance your allies can follow, then use Vi R Cease and Desist to catch Master Yi as soon as Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends. If Master Yi gets a takedown, he can immediately jump to another target, so have your team apply crowd control together to avoid leaving an ally alone. Keep attacking the Master Yi you caught to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block his escape route or knock him toward your allies.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can't be targeted while casting Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so use Vi R Cease and Desist just after he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows don't work, so respond with the knockback from Vi Q Vault Breaker or the knock-up from Vi R Cease and Desist. Armor can't block the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style.

MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first to defend against Wukong's main damage. Armor can't block the magic damage from Wukong E Nimbus Strike, and Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on max health, so avoid stacking only health. If Wukong's healing makes him hard to kill even when you catch him, buy Executioner's Calling between your core items.
MonkeyKing.combo: Identify the real Wukong after Wukong W Warrior Trickster leaves a clone, then target the real one. If you start with Vi R Cease and Desist, prepare Vi E Relentless Force while he is airborne, then when the knock-up ends, chain basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first to knock the real Wukong away can interrupt the follow-up.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes back up is your chance to engage. Check whether Wukong E Nimbus Strike is down too, then approach with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist. Look for a chance to force an objective or fight right after Wukong uses Wukong R Cyclone.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong P Stone Skin builds armor and healing the longer a fight lasts, so trade briefly and back off. Once Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker, and if Wukong E Nimbus Strike is down too, catch the real Wukong with Vi R Cease and Desist. While attacking at close range, keep the same target so Vi W Denting Blows triggers.
MonkeyKing.laning: When ganking, set up your approach from behind so Vi Q Vault Breaker can knock the enemy toward your allied laner. Before engaging, hitting a nearby minion or monster with an ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield can absorb the first damage.
MonkeyKing.phase: In late game, Vi's role shifts toward engaging and isolating a target rather than dealing more damage.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: Approach to a distance your allies can follow, then isolate a key damage dealer with Vi R Cease and Desist. Attack only that target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape route or knock them toward your allies.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash, so keep your distance outside its range. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster creates a clone, don't use Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist on the stationary clone; watch which way the real Wukong is heading.

Nidalee.build: Prioritize magic resistance to defend against Nidalee's damage. If Nidalee E Primal Surge means you can't kill her even when you catch her, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Nidalee.combo: After Nidalee W Pounce is down, engage with Vi R Cease and Desist to knock her up, and prepare Vi E Relentless Force while she lands. When the knock-up ends, chain basic attack → Vi E Relentless Force → basic attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first can knock Nidalee back and interrupt your follow-up.
Nidalee.escape: The moment after you make Nidalee use Nidalee W Pounce is your chance to close the gap. Approach with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch her with Vi R Cease and Desist. Nidalee has no crowd control, so check whether Nidalee W Pounce has been used before engaging.
Nidalee.fight: Dodge Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack to start the fight without a Hunt mark. Right after Nidalee uses Nidalee W Pounce, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch her with Vi R Cease and Desist. Keep attacking the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows.
Nidalee.laning: Check and clear traps at jungle entrances and in river with Control Ward or area-of-effect abilities before entering.
Nidalee.phase: In late game, focus on engaging and isolating targets rather than dealing damage.
Nidalee.teamfight: Remember where Nidalee came out to throw her spear, walk within a distance your allies can follow, then catch a key target with Vi R Cease and Desist. Keep attacking that target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block its escape route or knock it toward your allies.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther away she is, so dodge it especially when she's at long range and put a minion or allied frontline between you. Stepping on Nidalee W Bushwhack or getting hit by her spear applies Hunt, so check for traps at jungle entrances and in river. If Nidalee uses Nidalee W Pounce to engage after marking you, Nidalee Q Takedown can follow, so save Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist for that moment.

Nocturne.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia. If Nocturne P Umbra Blades’ healing keeps him alive when you engage, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, first remove the spell shield with Vi Q Vault Breaker, then use Vi R Cease and Desist. If you knock up a target without the shield using Vi R Cease and Desist, follow as they land with an attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Hitting the target first with Vi Q Vault Breaker can knock them away and interrupt the rest of the combo.
Nocturne.escape: If you’ve saved Vi Q Vault Breaker to deal with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, use it to create distance as soon as the tether connects.
Nocturne.fight: Stack Vi W Denting Blows on the same target to reduce their armor and make use of the attack speed increase. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, use Vi Q Vault Breaker to create distance and break the fear tether.
Nocturne.laning: When ganking, hit the target from behind with Vi Q Vault Breaker to knock them toward your allied laner. If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, don’t run straight along its trail; angle toward an ally or turret.
Nocturne.phase: In the late game, Vi’s role shifts more toward engaging and isolating targets than dealing damage.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, don’t scatter; immediately group up with your allies. Use Vi R Cease and Desist on an enemy carry from within range for your allies to follow, then focus that one target until Vi W Denting Blows triggers. Use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block the target’s escape or knock them toward your allies.
Nocturne.watch: Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability, and if it blocks one, Nocturne’s attack speed doubles. Check whether the spell shield is active before using Vi R Cease and Desist. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, create distance to break the tether before the fear triggers.

Nunu.build: If you can’t finish Nunu & Willump even after engaging because Nunu & Willump Q Consume heals so much, buy Executioner’s Calling early between core items. Get magic resistance first to withstand Nunu & Willump’s main damage.
Nunu.combo: For a gank, charge Vi Q Vault Breaker and knock Nunu & Willump toward your ally, then follow with an empowered attack from Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack. If you engage first with Vi R Cease and Desist, follow as the knock-up ends with attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first can knock them away and interrupt the follow-up.
Nunu.escape: After Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! passes or you dodge the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on their own, so focus on one target once you catch them, and use Vi R Cease and Desist to chase when needed.
Nunu.fight: Before a fight, hit a nearby minion or monster with a Vi ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield. Once you’re on Nunu & Willump, keep attacking the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and apply Grievous Wounds to account for the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. If Nunu & Willump uses Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero, interrupt the channel with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist instead of continuing to attack inside it.
Nunu.laning: Keep checking vision and lane position, since Nunu & Willump can return via the Rift Scuttler after a gank ends.
Nunu.phase: After learning Vi R Cease and Desist in the mid game, you have a better chance to lock down one target. In the late game, focus more on engaging and isolating targets than dealing damage, and move with your team.
Nunu.teamfight: Move within follow-up range of your allies, then use Vi R Cease and Desist to isolate one of the enemy’s main damage dealers and attack only that target until Vi W Denting Blows triggers. Use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape or knock them toward your allies. If Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero threatens your team, interrupt the channel with the crowd control from Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so when you see it, move toward the direction the snowball is coming from and dodge into the area Nunu & Willump has already passed through instead of running backward. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, use Vi Q Vault Breaker to get out before the delayed root lands. The slow from Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero grows stronger over time, so interrupt it with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist, or leave its area.

Poppy.build: Prioritize armor because the main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict is physical. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone. Don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance just to fight Poppy.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, engage with Vi R Cease and Desist to knock her up, then follow with attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first can knock Poppy away and interrupt the follow-up. Keep attacking without switching targets to trigger Vi W Denting Blows.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the gap. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, go in with Vi Q Vault Breaker, then use Vi R Cease and Desist so Poppy has a hard time getting away. If she is charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, first move to the side from in front of her.
Poppy.fight: Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, use Vi Q Vault Breaker to close the gap immediately after Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge. Once you’re on her, keep attacking the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and walk out of the area left by Poppy Q Hammer Shock. When Poppy’s health decreases, she gains more armor and magic resistance, so only commit deeply when you can secure the finishing damage.
Poppy.laning: When ganking, line up Vi Q Vault Breaker from behind the enemy so you can knock them toward your allied laner, but wait before dashing if Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it first to prevent her from gaining the shield.
Poppy.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and isolating targets more than dealing damage.
Poppy.teamfight: Walk within follow-up range of your allies, then use Vi R Cease and Desist on one of the enemy’s main damage dealers. Keep attacking only that target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape or knock them toward your allies. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait for it to end before engaging with Vi Q Vault Breaker.
Poppy.watch: If you charge at Poppy with Vi Q Vault Breaker while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it will be blocked and you temporarily won’t be able to use movement abilities. Wait for it to end or walk up to her. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so stay in open space. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, immediately walk out of the remaining area. If you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move to the side from in front of her.

Rammus.build: Get magic resistance first to deal with the damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. If you buy penetration to counter Rammus’s high armor, prioritize percent armor penetration over flat penetration.
Rammus.combo: After Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends, engage with Vi R Cease and Desist to knock him up, then time your follow-up for the landing: attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first can knock Rammus away and interrupt the follow-up.
Rammus.escape: When Rammus R Soaring Slam is down, engage by closing the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker. You can’t use abilities while Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is active, so account for that when timing Vi’s movement ability after the taunt ends.
Rammus.fight: Stop basic attacks when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, then focus your damage after it ends. If you need to kill Rammus at that point, keep hitting the same target to take advantage of Vi W Denting Blows’ armor reduction and percent maximum health damage.
Rammus.laning: When ganking, get behind your target to line up Vi Q Vault Breaker so you can knock them toward your allied laner. If Rammus Q Powerball is approaching, put a minion wave between you and him.
Rammus.phase: In the late game, Vi focuses more on engaging and isolating targets than dealing damage.
Rammus.teamfight: If you see Rammus rolling in quickly with Rammus Q Powerball, move away with the larger area of Rammus R Soaring Slam in mind. From within follow-up range of your allies, use Vi R Cease and Desist on one of the enemy’s main damage dealers. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, don’t attack Rammus with basic attacks; hit another target instead.
Rammus.watch: If you see Rammus Q Powerball coming, put minions between you to block the collision. Rammus R Soaring Slam has a large area when he rolls in quickly, so move away ahead of time and get out of the slow at the landing point. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents you from using abilities and moving, so fight outside its range.

RekSai.build: Get armor first to deal with Rek'Sai’s main damage. The true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel can’t be reduced with resistances, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone. If Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai heals enough that you can’t kill her after engaging, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
RekSai.combo: After Rek'Sai’s movement ability is down, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch her with Vi R Cease and Desist. While R knocks her up, prepare Vi E Relentless Force, then follow with attack → E → attack and keep hitting the same target. For a gank that starts with Q, collide so the target is knocked toward your ally, then follow with an empowered E attack → attack → E → attack.
RekSai.escape: The moment after you dodge the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow is your chance to get on her. Don’t engage just because Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down; check whether Rek'Sai R Void Rush is also available. In particular, approach with Vi Q Vault Breaker before Rek'Sai R comes back up and catch her with Vi R Cease and Desist.
RekSai.fight: Just before a fight, hit a nearby minion or monster with an ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield. Dodge the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then get on one target and keep attacking to trigger Vi W Denting Blows. If Rek'Sai burrows to heal, don’t give her space; keep attacking.
RekSai.laning: If you see a tunnel made by Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel near lane or in your own jungle, walk over its entrance to destroy it. Don’t push the lane too hard early, and don’t walk alone through areas without vision.
RekSai.phase: Early on, Rek'Sai tries to build an advantage through ganks, so it’s important not to give up kills. The matchup gets better the more safely you get through the early game. In the late game, Vi focuses on engaging and isolating targets more than dealing damage.
RekSai.teamfight: Move within follow-up range of your allies, then catch one of the enemy’s main damage dealers with Vi R Cease and Desist. Keep attacking the same target until Vi W Denting Blows triggers, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape or knock them toward your allies. Don’t use Vi R Cease and Desist during the untargetability from Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai goes underground with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, watch for the moment she leaps out and knocks you up. Avoid walls and narrow paths, move toward open space, and dodge the knock-up with Vi Q Vault Breaker as she emerges. Immediately after Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker hits you, Rek'Sai R Void Rush can follow, so stay close to your allies.

Rengar.build: Get armor first to deal with Rengar’s main damage. If Rengar W Battle Roar means you can’t kill him even after engaging, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Rengar.combo: When Rengar W Battle Roar is down and his resource bar is empty, engage first with Vi R Cease and Desist to knock him up. Prepare Vi E Relentless Force during the landing time, then follow with attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first and knocking Rengar away can interrupt the follow-up.
Rengar.escape: After you dodge Rengar E Bola Strike, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker. If Rengar W Battle Roar is also down, you have a chance to catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist. Rengar has no ability to create distance on his own once you’re on him, so keep attacking the same target during this window.
Rengar.fight: Engage when Rengar’s resource bar is empty, and catch him with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist right after Rengar W Battle Roar is used. Keep attacking the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, reducing their armor and increasing your attack speed. Save Vi Q Vault Breaker until after you dodge Rengar E Bola Strike.
Rengar.laning: Avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight, and use a Control Ward to gain vision of brush. When ganking, get behind your target so Vi Q Vault Breaker knocks them toward your allied laner.
Rengar.phase: After learning Vi R Cease and Desist in the mid game, use it to lock down one target. In the late game, Vi’s role shifts toward engaging and isolating targets, so start fights from within follow-up range of your allies.
Rengar.teamfight: Position your team so your back line stays behind the front line and within vision, then counter Rengar’s engage. When Rengar W Battle Roar is down, catch him with Vi Q Vault Breaker and Vi R Cease and Desist, and build Vi W Denting Blows stacks on one target. If you engage first with Vi R Cease and Desist, walk within follow-up range of your allies before using it.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and prepare an empowered ability, so avoid walking beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. If his resource bar is full, watch out for the root from Rengar E Bola Strike and the crowd control cleanse from Rengar W Battle Roar. Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike before using Vi Q Vault Breaker. Don’t roam alone while injured when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active.

Sejuani.build: Prioritize magic resistance for your first defensive investment because the main damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, Q Arctic Assault, and E Permafrost is magic damage. Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath deals physical damage, so magic resistance won’t block it. Sejuani P Fury of the North scales with maximum health, so be careful about relying on a large health increase alone.
Sejuani.combo: After Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, charge and collide with Vi Q Vault Breaker, then follow with an empowered attack from Vi E Relentless Force → attack → empowered attack from Vi E Relentless Force → attack. If you start with Vi R Cease and Desist, follow the knock-up with attack → empowered attack from Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker too early and knocking her away can interrupt the follow-up.
Sejuani.escape: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is her only movement ability, so immediately after she uses it is an opportunity to engage with Vi Q Vault Breaker. If you also use Vi R Cease and Desist then, Sejuani will have a hard time getting away. On the other hand, delay your engage and create distance when Sejuani E Permafrost stacks are building or you need to dodge Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Sejuani.fight: Bait out Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker. If her Frost Armor is active, deal damage first to create a window for its defensive stats and slow immunity to wear off. Once you’re on her, keep attacking Sejuani to trigger Vi W Denting Blows.
Sejuani.laning: When ganking, check whether Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, and get behind her so the collision from Vi Q Vault Breaker knocks her toward your allied laner. Secure early jungle control and objectives to delay Sejuani’s item timings.
Sejuani.phase: After learning Vi R Cease and Desist in the mid game, use the window when Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down to lock down a target. In the late game, secure objectives so Sejuani doesn’t get time to become increasingly tanky, and focus Vi on engaging and isolating targets over damage.
Sejuani.teamfight: Move within follow-up range of your allies, then use Vi R Cease and Desist to isolate one of the enemy’s main damage dealers. Watch for the wind-up of Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and R Glacial Prison and move sideways to dodge while finding an engage angle. After catching your target, attack only them until Vi W Denting Blows triggers, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape or knock them toward your allies.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault charges in and knocks you up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns for longer the farther it travels before hitting you. Move sideways to dodge when you see the wind-up. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, get out of range before the second strike, which deals concentrated damage and slows. Basic attacks from melee allies also build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks, so move away as the mark fills.

Shaco.build: Get magic resistance first to deal with the damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Magic resistance can’t block the physical damage from Shaco Q Deceive, so get some health too. Pick up movement speed to get out of placed boxes’ areas.
Shaco.combo: Once Shaco Q Deceive is down and he’s in range, start with Vi R Cease and Desist. Prepare Vi E Relentless Force while he’s knocked up, then follow as the knock-up ends with attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. If Vi Q Vault Breaker hits first and knocks Shaco away, it can interrupt the follow-up.
Shaco.escape: Shaco Q Deceive is his only movement ability, so immediately after he uses it is an opportunity to engage. If he’s far away, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist. On paths without vision where Shaco W Jack In The Box may be waiting, check for boxes before engaging.
Shaco.fight: When Shaco uses Shaco Q Deceive to get in and reveals himself, focus your damage with your allies. Keep attacking one real Shaco to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block his escape or knock him toward your allies. If Shaco uses Shaco R Hallucinate, identify the real one by watching how the health bars react.
Shaco.laning: Early on, maintain vision at your jungle entrances to watch for Shaco’s ganks and invades. Use a Control Ward or Oracle Lens to check Shaco W Jack In The Box around objectives where you have no vision.
Shaco.phase: Early on, watch for Shaco looking to gain an advantage through ganks and invades, don’t give up kills, and secure objectives. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in isolated fights, so Vi should focus on engaging and isolating targets over damage.
Shaco.teamfight: Move within follow-up range of your allies, then use Vi R Cease and Desist on one of the enemy’s main damage dealers. If Shaco engages first with Shaco Q Deceive, focus him with your allies when he can’t immediately escape. Don’t waste damage on the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate; identify the real Shaco, then keep attacking the same target until Vi W Denting Blows triggers.
Shaco.watch: If Shaco gets behind you with Shaco Q Deceive, his first basic attack is stronger, so face your allies or keep your back to a wall when he’s nearby. Watch out for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in brush without vision and around objectives. If you kill the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate, move away immediately to avoid the explosion and boxes.

Shyvana.build: Prioritize magic resistance for the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Get armor to handle the physical damage from her basic attacks too, but don’t rely on health alone because she has percent maximum health and true damage. If Shyvana’s healing means you can’t kill her after catching her, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Shyvana.combo: For a gank, charge Vi Q Vault Breaker and knock the target toward your ally, then follow with an empowered attack from Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack. If you start with Vi R Cease and Desist, knock the target up and prepare Vi E Relentless Force during the landing time, then follow with attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first and knocking the target away can interrupt the follow-up.
Shyvana.escape: Look for an engage when Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down or her Fury bar is empty. If she flies in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, wait until she lands before using Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist. Shyvana has no ability to create distance on her own, so keep pressuring one target after catching her.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury bar is empty or she has returned to human form. Close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and keep hitting one target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows. If Shyvana engaged with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, apply crowd control after she lands, and avoid staying close to her for a prolonged time while taking the explosion from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis.
Shyvana.laning: When ganking, get behind your target so Vi Q Vault Breaker knocks them toward your allied laner. Look for a chance to take jungle camps and objectives before Shyvana builds permanent stacks.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, Shyvana has few stacks of Shyvana P Scalemail, making it a good time to pressure her. The matchup becomes less favorable as Shyvana builds permanent stacks over time, so gain an advantage from early camps and objectives, and focus Vi on engaging and isolating targets in the late game.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out your formation so Shyvana’s dragon-form area attacks don’t hit several of you at once. Move within follow-up range of your allies before using Vi R Cease and Desist on an enemy’s main damage dealer, then focus that target until Vi W Denting Blows triggers. If Shyvana R Dragon's Descent hits an ally, catch her after she lands with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana is unstoppable while flying in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, so don’t try to interrupt her engage; catch her after she lands with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist. Watch out for the slow and percent maximum health damage from Shyvana E Molten Burst, and don’t stay on Shyvana for too long while Shyvana W Inferno Aegis is active, allowing her to deal damage and heal. While Shyvana is in dragon form, spread out from your allies so you aren’t hit by overlapping area attacks.

Skarner.build: First decide whether to buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If you build resistance, prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.combo: If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down and Skarner is in range of Vi R Cease and Desist, use Vi R Cease and Desist to knock him up and prepare Vi E Relentless Force. When the knockup ends, follow with an attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Hitting him first with Vi Q Vault Breaker can knock him away and interrupt the rest of the combo.
Skarner.escape: The window to approach with Vi Q Vault Breaker opens right after you make Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. However, if Skarner E Ixtal's Impact successfully slams its target into a wall, its cooldown is greatly reduced, so watch for his next dash and back off. Skarner R Impale can’t be interrupted by a stun, so don’t try to resolve it with Vi R Cease and Desist after you’ve been suppressed.
Skarner.fight: Make Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, then immediately close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker. Once you’re on him, keep attacking one target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and avoid trades where you take repeated hits from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval empowered attacks. Before engaging, you can hit nearby enemies with an ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield.
Skarner.laning: When ganking, Vi Q Vault Breaker’s collision knocks the target backward, so approach from behind at an angle that pushes Skarner toward your allied laner. Take early jungle control and objectives to delay Skarner’s tank items.
Skarner.phase: In the mid game, it’s important to delay Skarner’s items with jungle control and objectives. Once Skarner has tank items, he can withstand damage while continuing to hold you down, so Vi should focus on engaging and isolating targets in the late game rather than dealing damage.
Skarner.teamfight: Walk within range for your allies to follow, then target one of the enemy’s main damage dealers with Vi R Cease and Desist. Keep attacking that target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to cut off their escape or knock them toward your allies. Skarner R Impale pulls through terrain, so watch your position when engaging near the edge of the dragon or Baron pit.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain. If he hits a wall while carrying you, you’ll be stunned, so don’t stand with your back to a wall. Skarner R Impale is a suppression that movement abilities can’t remove, so be especially careful when you enter its range. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval empowered attacks and Skarner P Threads of Vibration deal damage based on maximum health, so don’t stay in melee and take repeated hits.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. If the crowd control from Taliyah W Seismic Shove into Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is difficult to handle, consider tenacity as well.
Taliyah.combo: Engage and knock Taliyah up with Vi R Cease and Desist from an angle that avoids crossing Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. When the knockup ends, follow with an attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first to knock Taliyah away can interrupt the rest of the combo.
Taliyah.escape: A good window to engage is after Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down and while Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is still down. If only Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down, she can escape with her other tools, so check the boulder field’s position and whether Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is available.
Taliyah.fight: Go around areas covered by Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, and close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker while Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is down. Once you’re on her, keep attacking the low-armor Taliyah to trigger Vi W Denting Blows. If you can hit a nearby enemy with an ability before engaging, activate Vi P Blast Shield.
Taliyah.laning: If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, she may intervene in another lane, so have your allies back off in advance.
Taliyah.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and isolating a target rather than dealing damage.
Taliyah.teamfight: Move within range for your allies to follow, then target Taliyah with Vi R Cease and Desist. Once you’re on her, focus your attacks on Taliyah alone until Vi W Denting Blows triggers. Use Vi Q Vault Breaker to cut off her escape or knock her toward your allies.
Taliyah.watch: Avoid Vi Q Vault Breaker engages across rocky ground. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley locks its cast direction, so sidestep it.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr. However, armor won’t block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types. If Udyr W Iron Mantle’s healing keeps him alive when you engage, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Udyr.combo: If a gap has opened after Udyr uses Udyr E Blazing Stampede, close it with Vi Q Vault Breaker, then catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist. If Vi R Cease and Desist can reach him first, knock him up and follow with an attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack, saving Vi Q Vault Breaker for the rest of the combo or to block his escape. Keep attacking only Udyr to trigger Vi W Denting Blows.
Udyr.escape: Udyr E Blazing Stampede is a mobility tool, so immediately after you make him use it, a window opens to close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker. If you’ve already taken the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, counterattack or escape during the window when that target can’t be stunned again for a while. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, wait for the empowerment to end, then lock him down with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist.
Udyr.fight: Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, focus your attacks on one target so he has no chance to heal. Vi W Denting Blows only triggers if you attack the same target repeatedly, so don’t switch targets. After taking one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, use the window when that target can’t be stunned again for a while.
Udyr.laning: When Udyr is out of sight, don’t step forward in lane; establish vision at key routes and jungle entrances. When ganking, approach from behind at an angle that pushes the target toward your allied laner with Vi Q Vault Breaker.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to force a kill on Udyr through his defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle; target weaker enemies behind him. Move within range for your allies to follow, then isolate one of the enemy’s main damage dealers with Vi R Cease and Desist. Focus that target until Vi W Denting Blows triggers, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to cut off their escape or knock them toward your allies.
Udyr.watch: Be careful of the stun on Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s first attack right after he activates it. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, so use Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist after the empowerment ends. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on maximum health.

Viego.build: Build armor first to mitigate the main damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Viego W Spectral Maw. If a duel drags on because of the healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King, build armor, then fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Viego.combo: When ganking, charge Vi Q Vault Breaker and collide with the target, then follow with an attack empowered by Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack. If you engage first with Vi R Cease and Desist, follow as the knockup ends with an attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first can knock Viego away and interrupt the rest of the combo.
Viego.escape: Don’t engage just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down; check whether Viego R Heartbreaker is available too. In particular, while Viego R Heartbreaker is still down, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist.
Viego.fight: Before a fight, hit a nearby minion or monster with an ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield, then engage. If Viego W Spectral Maw is charging, you can interrupt it with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist. Once you’re on him, keep attacking the same target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows.
Viego.laning: If you see black mist on terrain, don’t push the lane in that direction; avoid the route or place a Control Ward. Back off from skirmishes you can’t win so you don’t give Viego a kill.
Viego.phase: Once you learn Vi R Cease and Desist, you can lock down one target, so look for an opening when Viego’s mobility ability is down. In the late game, Vi should focus on engaging and isolating one target rather than dealing damage.
Viego.teamfight: Walk within range for your allies to follow, then isolate one of the enemy’s main damage dealers with Vi R Cease and Desist and focus them until Vi W Denting Blows triggers. If an ally is killed in front of Viego, knock Viego away or lock him down in place with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist to prevent possession. If Viego has already possessed someone, create distance and hold on, then counterattack the moment he returns to his original body.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more he charges it, so sidestep when you see him charging and, if possible, interrupt him with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist. If you see black mist on terrain, watch for Viego E Harrowed Path by avoiding that route or placing a Control Ward. When your health is low, fall back because you may be targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Armor also helps against his physical basic attack damage. If Warwick’s healing keeps him alive even after you stay on him for a long time, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Warwick.combo: If Warwick R Infinite Duress is still down, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist. While Vi R Cease and Desist knocks him up, prepare Vi E Relentless Force. When the knockup ends, follow with an attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first to knock Warwick away can interrupt the rest of the combo.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down; check whether Warwick R Infinite Duress is available too. In particular, while Warwick R Infinite Duress is still down, you have an opportunity to approach with Vi Q Vault Breaker and land Vi R Cease and Desist. If Warwick E Primal Howl is active, engage after the fear triggers.
Warwick.fight: Back off while Warwick E Primal Howl is active, then re-engage with Vi Q Vault Breaker after the fear triggers. Warwick heals with Warwick P Eternal Hunger and Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, so don’t dive just because he’s at half health. Once you’re on him, keep attacking one target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows.
