Warwick.laning: When health drops below half, the location is revealed to Warwick, so give up some farm and recall.
Warwick.phase: In the mid game, once you’ve learned Vi R Cease and Desist, you can lock down one target, so look for an opening while Warwick R Infinite Duress is still down. In the late game, Vi’s role shifts more toward engaging and isolating targets than dealing damage.
Warwick.teamfight: Move within range for your allies to follow, then isolate one of the enemy’s main damage dealers with Vi R Cease and Desist. Keep attacking that target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape or knock them toward your allies. If an ally is suppressed by Warwick R Infinite Duress, focus your counterattack while Warwick is locked in place.
Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and fears when it ends, so hold Vi’s burst and back off; engage after the fear. If you’re caught by Warwick R Infinite Duress, you can act while suppressed, so dodge with plenty of room for the leap. If Warwick W Blood Hunt has increased his movement speed, Warwick R Infinite Duress reaches farther than expected.

XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If Xin Zhao P Determination’s healing keeps him alive when you engage, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
XinZhao.combo: If Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, approach with Vi Q Vault Breaker and then catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist. If you’re close enough to start the combo with Vi R Cease and Desist, prepare Vi E Relentless Force during the knockup and follow with an attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Using Vi Q Vault Breaker first to knock Xin Zhao away can interrupt the rest of the combo.
XinZhao.escape: The window to engage opens right after you make Xin Zhao use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s third hit is imminent, first use Vi Q Vault Breaker to get out of range.
XinZhao.fight: Right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch him with Vi R Cease and Desist. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don’t force damage; create distance, wait out its duration, then counterattack. When fighting up close, don’t switch targets so Vi W Denting Blows can trigger.
XinZhao.laning: When ganking, approach from behind at an angle that pushes Xin Zhao toward your allied laner when he’s hit by Vi Q Vault Breaker. Before engaging, you can hit a nearby minion or monster with an ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield.
XinZhao.phase: In the late game, Vi’s role shifts more toward engaging and isolating targets than dealing damage. In late-game team fights, look to counterattack the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback can split your formation, so don’t stand right next to your allies. Damage from outside spear range doesn’t affect him while Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, so wait for its duration to end. Before engaging with Vi R Cease and Desist, move within range for your allies to follow. Once you’ve chosen a target, focus them until Vi W Denting Blows triggers.
XinZhao.watch: Dodge the follow-up thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. Dodging the thrust prevents you from being Challenged, which also denies the increased range on Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If you’ve been hit twice by Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s empowered attacks, use Vi Q Vault Breaker to get out of range before the third hit knocks you up.

Zac.build: If Zac P Cell Division’s healing makes him difficult to kill even when you catch him, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Zac’s Q, W, and E damage. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Zac.combo: Once Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, engage first with Vi R Cease and Desist to knock him up. When the knockup ends, follow with an attack → Vi E Relentless Force → attack → Vi Q Vault Breaker. Hitting Zac first with Vi Q Vault Breaker can knock him away and interrupt the rest of the combo.
Zac.escape: The window to close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker opens right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down. Follow with Vi R Cease and Desist to keep Zac from escaping. If Zac E Elastic Slingshot is charging, you can also interrupt the charge with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist.
Zac.fight: Make Zac use Zac E Elastic Slingshot, then immediately close the gap with Vi Q Vault Breaker. Once you’re on him, keep attacking one target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and step on the blobs dropped by Zac P Cell Division to prevent healing.
Zac.laning: When ganking, approach from behind at an angle that pushes Zac toward your allied laner when he’s hit by Vi Q Vault Breaker. If you hit a nearby minion or monster with an ability to activate Vi P Blast Shield before going in, you can absorb damage in the initial fight.
Zac.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and isolating a target rather than dealing damage, and check before the fight whether Zac P Cell Division can revive him.
Zac.teamfight: If you see Zac E Elastic Slingshot charging, interrupt it with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist. When targeting an enemy carry with Vi R Cease and Desist, walk within range for your allies to follow before using it. Once you’re in, attack one target to trigger Vi W Denting Blows, and use Vi Q Vault Breaker to block their escape or knock them toward your allies.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot has a visible charge, and he knocks you up when he lands. If you see him charging behind a wall, interrupt him with Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist. Watch out for the slow and knockup from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and create distance to avoid taking prolonged damage from Zac W Unstable Matter, which deals damage based on maximum health.
